changes.title: Test the release journeys in real browsers
changes.acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Assign a dedicated Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor tester separate from implementation. Drive the built pair in real Chrome and OpenCode's built-in browser with disposable accounts.

**Verify** · Record candidate SHA, versions and actual interactions for first run, older-store refusal, invites, reopen, sign-out, recovery, profile edits and account closure. Record limitations where a browser cannot exercise a scenario.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-075, WI-076

**Queue** · Follows WI-076 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
